numerical_gate: Every replay matches the checkpoint reference logits, committed stored-format KV hash, payload bytes and generated IDs. Also compare the reference trajectory with PR 76 at the same lengths.
timing_scope: Caller wall intervals around seven layer projections per layer, attention per layer, and one output projection. Each interval ends after worker joins. Other work is the remaining forward interval.
summary: Median of four per-replay averages in each mode. Report timer-on/control total ratio and stage milliseconds per batched decode call.
overhead_interpretation: A ratio outside 0.95–1.05 flags an affected case for investigation. Preserve it without retrying for a preferred result. This measures toggling timers within the copied instrumented binary.
source_boundary: Only the isolated build copy is instrumented. The production runtime source must remain byte-identical. Source, compiled-copy and binary hashes are retained.
purpose: Choose the next optimization target from elapsed stage intervals and keep CPU profile sample totals as a separate diagnostic.
